title: Nothing Passes Without a Rule
summary: If no rule covers a transaction, it is blocked, even when the owners sign.
lesson: No rule, no transaction: the owners signing is not enough on its own.
oneLiner: If no rule covers a transaction, it is blocked, even when the owners sign.
explain: With the Policy Guard installed, the owners signing is no longer enough. Each transaction also needs a rule that allows it.
You list what may happen, and everything else stops. Engineers call this deny by default.
Changing the Safe itself, like adding an owner, is a transaction too. It needs a rule as well.
takeaway: No rule, no transaction: the owners signing is not enough on its own.

steps.label: Pay Dave 500 USDC
steps.note: A rule covers USDC payments, and Dave is on its list.

steps.label: Send Dave 1 ETH
steps.note: No rule mentions ETH, so it is blocked. The owners signed, and that is not enough.

steps.label: Add Mallory as an owner
steps.note: Changing who owns the Safe needs a rule too. There is none, so nobody can be added.
